$comment: Structured verdict for the independent review gate. OpenAI strict structured output requires every property to appear in `required`, so optional fields are typed as nullable instead of omitted.

verdict.description: pass = merge as is. minor = style, naming, or a missing test case only. substantial = any correctness or security defect, any packages/contracts violation, or any acceptance test that does not actually exercise the behaviour it claims. fail = the unit does not implement its spec.

summary.description: Two or three sentences. What the diff does, and why it earned this verdict.

line.description: 1-indexed line, or null when the finding is about something absent.

claim.description: The defect, stated as a fact about the code.

spec_ref.description: The section or contract violated, e.g. 'SPEC 8.1' or '00-CONTRACTS ErrorCode'.

why_it_matters.description: Concrete consequence: the inputs or state that produce the wrong outcome.

spec_coverage.description: One entry per acceptance item in the unit spec, and whether the diff actually satisfies it.

evidence.description: The file and symbol that satisfies it, or a statement of what is missing.
